summary:
The package-only CLI-to-Governance Verify/GateExecution qualification (SDD#1131, PR #1132) joins the Verify host's capture lifetime to the maintained runner. One Verify provider invocation owns one capture session and the Verify host alone releases it; the OUTER runtime is the sole supplier of the original ends (FSGG_VERIFY_WORK_SECONDS and FSGG_VERIFY_CLEANUP_SECONDS, whole seconds measured from the host's own start, cleanup absolute and not before work). The runner (command captureLifetime) refuses a declaration unless startup allowance plus cleanup end fit inside its own work window, so it never signals a host inside its window, requires native-runtime with the pid-namespace backend for whole-worker teardown, and rejects the ends in the command environment so there is one supplier.

Reusable lessons. Classify a Verify ending only from the host's own mapping and reports: exit 0 and 1 with no unsettled report inside the window are the only settlement; exit 3 (input unavailable) is returned both before any session exists and after planning, so it implies no settlement; exit 4, crashes and runner-ended workers are non-passing. Check teardown two ways: a cooperative descendant witness of outer pid plus kernel start time, and a non-cooperative per-run environment-marker scan of /proc; an empty witness proves nothing. A qualification driver must hard-fail when a leg cannot run: a missing tool digest once skipped the authoring and Verify legs while the run still reported passed. Refusal cases must assert their intended diagnostic, not only an exit code. Pin published tool package digests in the driver and verify them against fresh downloads. Select the exact 10.0.12 runtime for the catalog transport profile, not the first 10.0.x listed. Authentic blocked regular-file reads and uncertain physical close stay Governance#423 prerequisite (b); the resident-host branch is only tested with a stand-in host.
title: Verify capture-lifetime join and qualification lessons
